run_stacked_agent_eval: run the stacked agent evaluation script with a specified number of examples from a ParlAI task
run_interactive_knowledge_conditioning: run the stacked agent evaluation interactively to condition dialogue generation on user-provided knowledge
run_eval_with_save: run the stacked agent evaluation and save the knowledge and dialogue responses to a JSON file
run_eval_random_order: run the stacked agent evaluation with examples processed in random order for diverse sampling
run_eval_verbose: run the stacked agent evaluation in verbose mode to print knowledge predictions and gold labels
